items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of collapsible sections — single or multiple open, animated height, a rotating chevron, full keyboard support.

meta.whenToUse: Group related content into collapsible sections — FAQs, settings groups.
meta.whenNotToUse: Hiding critical content, or sequential steps (stepper).

items.name: action-bar
items.title: Action Bar
items.description: Floating contextual bar — status region + action children, CSS-only enter/exit, raised band. Bulk selection, unsaved changes, and batch progress are recipes over it.

meta.whenToUse: A floating bar of contextual actions tied to transient state — N selected, unsaved changes, a batch operation in flight. The host owns the state; the bar shows status and actions.
meta.whenNotToUse: Transient outcome notifications (toast), page-level primary actions (PageHeader), or owning selection — the host's list keeps selectedIds.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A status banner — upstream's two variants plus our three extra status tones (COL-12); buttons inside a status alert hover in the family's own tint and ink, never white.

meta.whenToUse: Persistent, in-page status messages — info, success, warning, or error context tied to surrounding content.
meta.whenNotToUse: Transient feedback after a user action — use a toast instead.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts for a decision — media slot, two sizes, and an action/cancel footer.

meta.whenToUse: A decision that must be made before anything else continues — deleting, discarding, signing out.
meta.whenNotToUse: Anything dismissible by clicking away, or a form — use a Dialog.

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated Number
items.description: A number display that tweens from its previous value to a new one on every change — Intl.NumberFormat-aware (currency/percent/compact), instant under reduced motion, the dashboard stat-card counter.

meta.whenToUse: A numeric stat/metric that updates over time and should visually count/tween to its new value — dashboard KPIs, live prices, counters.
meta.whenNotToUse: A static number that never changes after render — just render it directly; the tween machinery adds nothing.

items.name: announcement-banner
items.title: Announcement Banner
items.description: A dismissible one-line announcement — full-width inverse band or inline hairline card.

meta.whenToUse: One temporary message with one action (releases, promos, sync prompts).
meta.whenNotToUse: Status feedback (Alert/Toast) or permanent notices (Alert strip).

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: The shared dashboard layout — a skip-linked sidebar + header + scrollable main region, composing Sidebar/SidebarTrigger into one reusable, hash-tracked shell.

meta.whenToUse: The root layout for a dashboard/console app — sidebar + header + main content, shared across every downstream VegaStack app; AppShellPage gives every page one container — gutters, rhythm and a narrow/default/full measure.
meta.whenNotToUse: A marketing/docs page with no persistent nav rail, or an app that already owns an equivalent shell — compose Sidebar/PageHeader/Breadcrumb directly instead.

items.name: record-layout
items.title: Record Layout
items.description: A record page's main column beside a sticky right rail of cards, with an ⓘ Details sheet in its place on small screens.

meta.whenToUse: A record's page (a meeting, a customer, a deal): the main column with a sticky rail of property and related-work cards on wide screens, and an ⓘ Details sheet on small ones.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list page (DataList), or a page with no per-record facts — use AppShellPage alone.

items.name: comments
items.title: Comments
items.description: A record's comments: a list with a count, Load earlier, skeleton and empty states, comments with edit/delete/copy link and emoji reactions, and a composer.

meta.whenToUse: Discussion on a record's page (a task, a meeting): comments oldest first with the composer at the end.
meta.whenNotToUse: An activity feed or notifications — use Inbox.

items.name: reactions
items.title: Reactions
items.description: Slack-style emoji reactions: pills with counts that toggle, a hover card naming who reacted, and an add-reaction button with quick reactions.

meta.whenToUse: Letting people react to a comment, message or post with emoji.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single like or rating — use a toggle button.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Constrains its children to a given width-to-height ratio.

meta.whenToUse: Reserve a fixed ratio for media — a video embed, a cover image, a map tile — so the layout does not shift as it loads.
meta.whenNotToUse: Content whose height must follow its text; use ordinary flow instead.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file chip / thumbnail card for chat, record-file and upload-queue surfaces — media slot, name + meta, idle/uploading/processing/error/done states, determinate progress, a muted tile, an actions row, a full-bleed trigger, and a scrolling or grid group.

meta.whenToUse: File and media tiles on any surface: chat attachments, record files, upload queues — a chip or thumbnail with name, size, lifecycle state, determinate upload progress (AttachmentProgress), a muted tile for a file no longer in use, and remove or download actions; AttachmentGroup lays them out as a scrolling row or a grid.
meta.whenNotToUse: Acquiring files (drop, browse, paste) - that is Dropzone; Attachment renders the files after acquisition.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: A compact custom audio transport with play/pause, skip, seek, a tappable speed control, and keyboard shortcuts — a single line on a wide player, two lines with an optional transcript control on a narrow, mobile-width player; a floating pill variant and a global AudioPlayerProvider + useGlobalPlayer that keep one recording playing across routes.

meta.whenToUse: A single audio asset that needs a compact, branded transport with rewind/forward, a tappable speed control, keyboard shortcuts, and a two-line mobile layout with an optional transcript control; `docked` pins a closable player to the bottom of a scroll column, a function `src` resolves a signed URL on first play, and `actionsRef` seeks it from a transcript or chapter list.
meta.whenNotToUse: Playlists, queue management, waveform editing, audio recording, or a bar of bulk actions over a selection (ActionBar).

items.name: auto-save-input
items.title: Auto Save Input
items.description: An input that debounces edits and persists them via an async onSave, with an inline idle/saving/saved/error status.

meta.whenToUse: Settings-style fields that save on pause without a Save button — names, slugs, inline fields.
meta.whenNotToUse: Form submission with a Save button, secrets, or one-time codes.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A circular user or entity image with a fallback, a badge, and an overlapping group.

meta.whenToUse: Represent a user/entity with a photo, falling back to initials — alone or stacked in a group.
meta.whenNotToUse: When you must fetch/resolve the image source — presentational; resolve R2/CDN keys app-side.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact label or status chip — upstream's six variants plus our four status tones (COL-12).

meta.whenToUse: Label or annotate status, counts, or categories — e.g. Active, Beta, 3 New.
meta.whenNotToUse: An action — use a Button. A Badge is a label; it can be a link through render, but never a control.

items.name: board
items.title: Board
items.description: Kanban lanes — full-height lanes that scroll their cards inside, sticky headers with a collapse button left of the ⋯ menu, transparent lanes, + Add at each lane's foot, Nothing here / Drop here empty zones, per-lane skeletons and load-on-scroll paging; live pointer and touch drag (lift, make room, settle, edge auto-scroll), a keyboard pick-up/move/drop model, a per-card ⋯ menu of the card's own actions, optimistic moves with rollback and a toast, and one lane at a time on a phone.

meta.whenToUse: Cross-column card movement — pipelines, kanban, staged workflows — where the host owns ordering and the move can be refused by a server gate; lanes may be partially loaded (count shows the total) and cards may be links to their records.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single-list reordering (sortable-list), tabular data (data-list/data-grid), or static column layouts with no movement (plain Cards in a flex row).

items.name: board-card
items.title: Board Card
items.description: A work item as a board card — a round completion tick, a two-line title, a muted context line, and a bottom row with the due chip (destructive when overdue, warning when due today), the priority chip, a source icon and the assignee's avatar.

meta.whenToUse: The content of a Board card (tasks, deals, tickets) — DataList's board view renders one per row — or a standalone work-item card.
meta.whenNotToUse: A record with an image (MediaCard), a long body (Card), or a table row (DataList).

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A hierarchical navigation trail — links, separators, the current page, and ellipsis collapse for long paths.

meta.whenToUse: Show location in a hierarchy and navigate back up — nested pages, file trees.
meta.whenNotToUse: Primary navigation or a menu — a breadcrumb reflects location only.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A chat speech bubble - 7 token-driven variants (incl. brand-tinted), start/end alignment, interactive content, and a floating reactions chip.

meta.whenToUse: The speech surface inside a Message - sent/received styling, reactions, interactive bubbles.
meta.whenNotToUse: Non-conversational callouts - use Alert or Card.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Trigger an action — upstream's six variants and eight sizes, plus a loading state (API-5).

meta.whenToUse: Any clickable action — submit, confirm, destructive, etc.
meta.whenNotToUse: Navigation to a URL — style the link with buttonVariants(): <Link href className={buttonVariants({ variant, size })}>.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins buttons, inputs, selects and dropdowns into one connected control group — horizontal or vertical, with a separator and a text addon.

meta.whenToUse: Join related controls into one unit — a split action, a segmented action bar, an input with a leading or trailing control.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single selection among peers (ToggleGroup) or unrelated actions that only happen to sit together.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A date-field calendar built on react-day-picker — single, multiple and range selection, month/year dropdowns, week numbers and custom cell sizes.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing one or more dates from a month grid — a booking range, a report period, a due date inside a Popover.
meta.whenNotToUse: A free-text date a user already knows (an input with a mask) or a time-only value.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A content surface with composable header, content, footer and action parts.

meta.whenToUse: Group related content into a bordered surface — summaries, plan tiles, settings sections.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single standalone values or page layout regions; never nest cards or add shadows.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A slide track with previous and next controls — horizontal or vertical, any slide size or spacing, Embla options, events and plugins.

meta.whenToUse: A horizontal or vertical run of peer items the reader scrolls through one or a few at a time — a gallery, a set of feature cards, a testimonial run.
meta.whenNotToUse: Content the reader must not miss, or a list they need to scan and compare — put that in the page, not behind a control.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A themed Recharts wrapper — a ChartConfig that maps each series to a colour and a label, a bordered tooltip and legend, and Recharts' own built-in keyboard + screen-reader layer.

meta.whenToUse: Visualizing series data (trends, comparisons, breakdowns) with a Line/Bar/Area/Pie/Radar chart that needs to match the design system's theme automatically in light and dark. Draw a one-series chart in --chart-single and reach for --chart-1…--chart-8 from two series up.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabular/exact-value data a user needs to read precisely (Table), a single KPI number (a stat tile), or a progress/completion metric (Progress).

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A binary (or indeterminate) toggle built on Base UI Checkbox, with a 24px invisible hit area (A11Y-2).

meta.whenToUse: Toggle a single option on/off, accept terms, or drive a 'select all' parent with indeterminate.
meta.whenNotToUse: Mutually-exclusive choices (RadioGroup); instant self-saving settings (Switch).

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: The one labelled pill primitive — 10 decorative hues, two tiers, an optional selection rung, and a real 24x24 remove control. Behind Tag and FilterChip; ComboboxChip is Base UI's own chip, not this primitive.

meta.whenToUse: A labelled, optionally removable pill — a record label, an applied filter, a selected value in a multi-select.
meta.whenNotToUse: A status signal (Badge) or a clickable action (Button); a Chip's root is not interactive.

items.name: chip-input
items.title: Chip Input
items.description: Free-token entry field — Enter/comma/paste commits chips, Backspace removes, per-chip validation marks invalid entries instead of dropping them. InputGroup field chrome + real Tag chips.

meta.whenToUse: Entering an open set of short tokens — tags, e-mail recipients, domains, webhook events — where values are typed or pasted, not picked from a finite list.
meta.whenNotToUse: Selection from a known item set (Combobox multiple), or a read-only label list (TagGroup).

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A code panel with a language header and copy affordance — the shared code surface for chat transcripts, docs, and examples.

meta.whenToUse: Fenced/source code that deserves a labelled, copyable panel.
meta.whenNotToUse: Inline code (a mono chip) or terminal output theatre (Terminal).

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single toggleable open/close region with an animated height, built on Base UI Collapsible.

meta.whenToUse: A single show/hide region — extra detail, an optional form section, 'read more'.
meta.whenNotToUse: Several coordinated sections where one opens at a time — use Accordion.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A swatch-triggered popover presenting a grid of preset colors — pick one, fire onValueChange, mark the selection.

meta.whenToUse: Pick a single color from a small curated set — labels, tags, calendar categories.
meta.whenNotToUse: Full-spectrum hue/saturation/alpha selection.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A filterable, keyboard-navigable listbox behind a text input — type-to-filter, grouped items, an announced empty state, and a multi-select chips mode.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing from a large or dynamic set that benefits from typing to narrow it down — searchable pickers, tag/label multi-select, async-loaded results. A two-line option composes ItemTitle + ItemDescription, and the description is the option's accessible description.
meta.whenNotToUse: A small, fixed set with no need to search (Select), boolean on/off (Switch), or a few always-visible options (radios/checkboxes).

items.name: command
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: A searchable command palette — filtered, grouped items with keyboard navigation, optionally inside a ⌘K dialog.

meta.whenToUse: A keyboard-first command palette — global ⌘K, action launchers, a filtered list of things to do or go to — including a large palette over server results, with a loading status, two-line results and a footer of key hints.
meta.whenNotToUse: Picking a form value, and never a multi-select — Command's check mark is visual only (Select, SearchableSelect or Combobox) — or a small static action menu (DropdownMenu).

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: The same menu vocabulary opened by right-click, positioned at the pointer.

meta.whenToUse: Secondary actions on an object the user has already found — a file row, a canvas node, a board card. A two-line row composes ItemTitle + ItemDescription, and the description is the row's accessible description — including a disabled row's reason.
meta.whenNotToUse: The only way to reach an action — right-click is discoverable by almost nobody; pair it with a visible menu.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copy a value to the clipboard with transient check feedback — icon-only by default, with an optional visible status label.

meta.whenToUse: Copy a short opaque value — API key, invite link, ID, snippet — with clear confirmation.
meta.whenNotToUse: Long-form content to read/edit, or when there is no discrete value to copy.

items.name: country-select
items.title: Country Select
items.description: A searchable country picker returning the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, with flag + name. A thin wrapper over SearchableSelect fed by the geo-data item.

meta.whenToUse: Collecting a country in an address/billing form — store the ISO code.
meta.whenNotToUse: A small fixed option set (Select) or multi-select.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: The full-parity grid — TanStack-sorted multi-key sort, column picker with responsive revelation, collapsible grouping, keyboard-continuous load-more, opt-in virtualization, and an APG grid keyboard layer with inline cell editing.

meta.whenToUse: Record tables that need grouping, inline cell editing, multi-key sort, column management, or 10k+ rows via virtualization — the CRM pipeline-table tier.
meta.whenNotToUse: Simple presentational record lists — DataList is lighter and still the right default; kanban views (Board).

items.name: data-list
items.title: Data List
items.description: A generic, typed data table — configurable columns, row selection, sortable columns (indicator, custom compare and first direction, client or manual), a standard rowActions ⋯ column always last, untinted-link rows (no underline), loading, and Empty-based emptyState and noResults states.

meta.whenToUse: A list of records as a table, a card grid or board lanes (view) with typed columns, selection, click-to-sort, loading/empty states, keyset paging through loadMore, rows as links, sections, thumbnails and a row-actions column.
meta.whenNotToUse: Full-parity grids with grouping/editing/virtualization (DataGrid), or a simple static table (Table).

items.name: data-list-pager
items.title: Data List Pager
items.description: A controlled paging footer for DataList — a tabular-numeral range summary, a rows-per-page Select, and a windowed Pagination that hides on a single page.

meta.whenToUse: Paging a DataList (or any host-paged list) in place: the range, an optional rows-per-page chooser (omit onPageSizeChange for a fixed size), and page buttons in its footer slot, with page state owned by the host.
meta.whenNotToUse: Keyset or cursor paging with no total (LoadMore, or DataList's and DataGrid's loadMore), or bare page links with no page-size choice (Pagination).

items.name: load-more
items.title: Load More
items.description: The shared Load more footer for keyset lists — an outline button that keeps its width while loading, an error line with Try again, and an optional end caption.

meta.whenToUse: The footer of a keyset (cursor) list — DataList's or DataGrid's loadMore, a board lane, a feed: load the next batch, retry a failed one, optionally say the list has ended.
meta.whenNotToUse: Numbered pages with a known total (DataListPager); loading on scroll with no button.

items.name: media-card
items.title: Media Card
items.description: A record as a card — an image, the title, a meta line, a badge and a ⋯ menu — where the whole card is one link.

meta.whenToUse: A card per record in a grid (DataList view="grid" renders one per row), or card content on a board.
meta.whenNotToUse: A record with a long body or its own controls (Card), or a row in a table (DataList).

items.name: thumbnail
items.title: Thumbnail
items.description: A small rounded, cover-fit image, 32 or 48px, with a fallback for records that have no image.

meta.whenToUse: A record image in a list row (32px) or a card (48px), with the app mark as the fallback.
meta.whenNotToUse: A person (Avatar), a large image or media (Image), or an icon (Icon).

items.name: view-toggle
items.title: View Toggle
items.description: The Grid | List | Board icon switch for a list page, labels hidden on a phone.

meta.whenToUse: Switching a list page between list, grid and board views — DataList mounts it for you with onViewChange.
meta.whenNotToUse: A scope switch such as Mine | Team (default Tabs), or a form value (RadioGroup).

items.name: data-table-parts
items.title: Data Table Parts
items.description: The chrome DataList and DataGrid share — sort header, selection cells, skeleton rows, the empty row, column class rules, and the selection/sort/controlled-state hooks.

meta.whenToUse: Installed automatically with DataList or DataGrid; import it directly when building a bespoke table that should share their sort header, selection cells and column rules.
meta.whenNotToUse: A plain presentational table (Table alone), or as a table component in its own right — these are parts, not a renderer.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Pick a single date or a date range from a calendar popover — token-styled, keyboard-navigable, with optional quick presets.

meta.whenToUse: Selecting a single date or a range (with optional Today/Last-7-days presets) from a popover. size="sm" + variant="ghost" is the inline row tier; clearable adds a clear control that returns focus to the trigger.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-form/partial dates (masked Input) or inline-only calendars (use Calendar directly).

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal overlay — backdrop, centred popup, a plain right-aligned footer and an optional close button; opens onto the first field or the popup, never the close ×.

meta.whenToUse: Modal interactions requiring full attention — confirmations, focused forms, destructive-action prompts. size sm/default/lg/xl steps the width; put long content in DialogBody so the header and footer stay in view.
meta.whenNotToUse: Non-blocking feedback (Toast), inline contextual content (Popover/Tooltip), or a swipeable bottom panel (Drawer).

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Base UI's DirectionProvider and useDirection — the text-direction context every component reads for its logical-property layout.

meta.whenToUse: Rendering a right-to-left subtree, or reading the active direction inside a component.
meta.whenNotToUse: Setting the document direction — that is the `dir` attribute on <html>.

items.name: date-time
items.title: Date Time
items.description: The one Intl-based dates & times module — formatRelative, formatDuration, formatDate, formatDateTime, formatDateRange, formatTimeOfDay, formatDueLabel, groupByDay, and the tz cookie + getTimeZone server helper. Plain functions for server and client.

meta.whenToUse: Any date, time, duration, due label or day grouping shown as text — on the server, in route handlers, emails or client code.
meta.whenNotToUse: API/JSON output — keep ISO strings there.

items.name: drag-item
items.title: Drag Item
items.description: The one visual recipe for a use-drag-reorder item — drop-edge hairlines on all four edges, the lift dim, and the pending shimmer — shared by Board and SortableList instead of copied into each.

meta.whenToUse: Building a drag surface on use-drag-reorder — spread it onto the element carrying the hook`s getItemProps() attributes.
meta.whenNotToUse: File drag-in (use-file-drop) or any surface that does not use the reorder hook.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A swipeable panel with snap points — four directions, a swipe handle, nesting, and a non-modal mode.

meta.whenToUse: A touch-first panel the user drags — a mobile action sheet, a half-height detail panel, a stack of nested steps.
meta.whenNotToUse: A desktop side panel with no gesture (Sheet), or a centred modal (Dialog).

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: An anchored action menu — items, submenus, checkboxes, radio groups, shortcuts and a destructive variant.

meta.whenToUse: A list of actions or option toggles anchored to a button — row actions, an account menu, a view switcher. A two-line row composes ItemTitle + ItemDescription, and the description is the row's accessible description — including a disabled row's reason.
meta.whenNotToUse: Choosing a form value (Select), navigating between pages (NavigationMenu), or content the user reads (Popover).

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: File acquisition surface — drop, click-to-browse, and paste — as a thin shell over use-file-drop; the surface is the named focusable control over a hidden picker-bridge input; data-dragging/data-drag-invalid styling flags.

meta.whenToUse: A visible upload surface — drop files, click to browse, paste — that hands accepted File[]s to the host and typed rejections back.
meta.whenNotToUse: Chrome-less acquisition inside another surface (compose use-file-drop directly) or rendering the staged files and their upload progress (Attachment with AttachmentProgress, laid out by AttachmentGroup).

items.name: editable-cell
items.title: Editable Cell
items.description: Inline-editable value whose edit mode looks like view — same box, inherited type, no border — with optimistic saves, a delayed spinner, rollback plus a Retry toast on failure, required, multiline, table-cell and heading variants, and a typed text/select/custom editor registry.

meta.whenToUse: Any optimistic inline edit of a single value — grid cells (focusMode=managed), record-page property lists, settings rows — where the write is async and can fail.
meta.whenNotToUse: Debounced save-as-you-type on a standing form field (AutoSaveInput), or whole forms (Field).

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.description: A popover with a quick row, search, a category bar, recents and a category-grouped grid of emoji that returns the selected character via onValueChange (curated set, loaded lazily).

meta.whenToUse: Lightweight emoji insertion — reactions, comments, status, icon selection.
meta.whenNotToUse: A complete Unicode emoji browser — extend the embedded set or use a library.

items.name: panel-search
items.title: Panel Search
items.description: The sticky, box-free search row a filtering popup puts at the top of its panel (decision OVL-11) — shared by EmojiPicker and ShortcutOverlay.

meta.whenToUse: Installed automatically with EmojiPicker or ShortcutOverlay; import it directly when building another popup that filters its own contents.
meta.whenNotToUse: A standalone search field on a page — that is Input, or InputGroup with a leading addon. A command palette is Command, which brings its own input.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A zero-data placeholder — always an icon (the icon prop, Inbox by default), title, description and a content slot, with a compact sm size for inline empties. The one empty-state markup: DataList's emptyState and noResults (SearchX, "No matches", Clear filters) are built on it.

meta.whenToUse: When a list, table, or panel has no content — communicate the zero state and offer the next action.
meta.whenNotToUse: While loading (skeleton/spinner) or for transient post-action feedback (toast).

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: The form-field scaffold — label, description, error, legend, separator and choice-card layouts in vertical, horizontal or responsive orientation.

meta.whenToUse: Wrap any form control to give it a label, description and error message: inside a Field the control gets its label, aria-describedby ids and aria-invalid from Base UI Field with no ids to wire.
meta.whenNotToUse: A bare control with its own label already wired — Field is for the label+message+a11y scaffold.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: The two-row toolbar above a list or table — search (~320px) left; a Filters (n) toggle, scope Tabs and the view switch right; compact rounded-md filter chips (FilterBarFacet, DateRangeFilter with presets) on a toggled row 12px below that scrolls sideways on a phone.

meta.whenToUse: Filter toolbars for lists/tables — 'Label: value' chips that edit in place, facets on SearchableSelect, an Add-filter menu and a settled search, at the end or first.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single search box (Input), value selection (Select), or unrelated row actions.

items.name: filter-bar-managed
items.title: Filter Builder
items.description: The controlled nested and/or filter builder — host-injected field grammar (vocabulary + per-type value editors), depth and condition caps, focus-managed removal, and a removable FilterChip summary.

meta.whenToUse: Editing a filter or a rule as data: nested and/or groups, or flat condition rules (allowGroups={false}) with a sentence summary, host-injected fields and typed value editors.
meta.whenNotToUse: A presentational chip row over host-owned filter state (filter-bar), or free-text search (Input in a toolbar).

items.name: geo-data
items.title: Geo Data
items.description: The ISO 3166-1 country list and the states/provinces map behind CountrySelect and RegionSelect, plus their two lookups. Pure data — installed once, shared by both selects.

meta.whenToUse: Any surface that needs the country or subdivision lists — the two selects, a shipping-rate table, a billing-address validator.
meta.whenNotToUse: A curated subset (pass your own array to the select) or data that has to come from a server.

items.name: emoji-data
items.title: Emoji Data
items.description: The curated emoji set behind EmojiPicker and Reactions, in nine categories, plus a lookup by character and a search matcher. Pure data, loaded lazily by the picker.

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: A presentational framed image with aspect-ratio, rounding, a loading skeleton, and an error fallback.

meta.whenToUse: Display a resolved image URL with reserved aspect-ratio, a loading skeleton, and a graceful error fallback.
meta.whenNotToUse: When you must fetch/resolve the source (R2/CDN keys) — presentational; resolve URLs app-side.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A styled Base UI input for every text-entry type — Field-aware state, invalid and disabled chrome, and the text-entry focus border tint (FOC-3).

meta.whenToUse: Single-line text entry — email, password, search, URL/slug with a domain prefix, numbers, etc.
meta.whenNotToUse: Multi-line text (use a textarea) or choosing from fixed options (use a select/radio).

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input or textarea with addons — icons, text, buttons, kbd hints, spinners and dropdowns, aligned inline or block, sharing one bordered surface.

meta.whenToUse: A text control that needs an affordance on the same surface — a search icon, a currency prefix, a reveal button, a character counter.
meta.whenNotToUse: A control whose affordance belongs outside the field — use a Field description or a ButtonGroup.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time-password field with per-character slots — copy/paste aware, patterned, separable, and driven by one hidden input.

meta.whenToUse: Entering a short verification code — 2FA, email confirmation, a device-pairing PIN.
meta.whenNotToUse: Any value longer than a handful of characters, or one the user may not know the length of — use an Input.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A composable row for list and feed content — media, title, description, actions — with a highlighted flash for a just-changed row.

meta.whenToUse: A row of structured content in a feed, list, or panel — a person, file, notification, or settings link — with optional media and trailing actions. Rows rendered as links or buttons can sit inside an ItemGroup (the list item moves to a wrapper), and ItemGroupLabel names a group.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabular/sortable data with columns (use Table or DataList) or a zero-data placeholder (use Empty).

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard-key chip, and a group that lays several of them out inline.

meta.whenToUse: Display a keyboard shortcut or key in menus, tooltips, command palettes, help text.
meta.whenNotToUse: As an interactive control or to capture keystrokes — Kbd is presentational only.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A styled native label for form controls.

meta.whenToUse: Label any form control — pair via htmlFor/id or by wrapping. Mark a mandatory field on the control itself (required, aria-required) and say so in the label text.
meta.whenNotToUse: As a heading, or when you need a full field layout — use Field.

items.name: markdown-view
items.title: Markdown View
items.description: Render a markdown string to safe, token-styled HTML — headings, lists, code, blockquotes, links, GFM tables — XSS-safe, no raw HTML.

meta.whenToUse: Display user/system-authored markdown — descriptions, comments, activity — as safe token-styled prose.
meta.whenNotToUse: Editing markdown (use an editor), or when the source needs embedded raw HTML.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: An inline conversation marker - status lines, system notes, and labelled dividers. 3 variants, Base UI render-polymorphic.

meta.whenToUse: Annotate a thread inline - a merged/status line, a date divider, or a small action row.
meta.whenNotToUse: A standalone status chip outside a conversation (use Badge) or a full banner (use Alert).

items.name: media-player-controls
items.title: Media Player Controls
items.description: The shared media transport — play/pause, seek, elapsed/duration, mute + volume, playback speed, and one keyboard shortcut map — composed by Audio Player and Video Player.

meta.whenToUse: You are building a player around your own <audio>/<video> element and want the VegaStack transport, chrome and keyboard map.
meta.whenNotToUse: A ready-made player — reach for Audio Player or Video Player, which compose this.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A persistent horizontal bar of menus — application-style File / Edit / View navigation.

meta.whenToUse: A desktop-application shell where several menus stay visible and move focus between each other. A two-line row composes ItemTitle + ItemDescription, and the description is the row's accessible description — including a disabled row's reason.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single button's actions (DropdownMenu), or site navigation (NavigationMenu).

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Layout primitives for a conversation row - avatar anchoring, content column, header/footer slots, start/end alignment. Server-safe.

meta.whenToUse: Lay out a chat/AI conversation row - compose Avatar, Bubble, and Marker as children.
meta.whenNotToUse: A non-conversational list row - use a plain layout or Data List / Settings Row.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: An auto-scrolling conversation viewport (not virtualised) - pins to the latest message, preserves position on prepend, tracks the anchor, and a floating scroll-to-end button.

meta.whenToUse: A live chat/AI thread that must auto-scroll, keep its place when older messages load, and offer a jump-to-latest control.
meta.whenNotToUse: A short, static list that fits without scrolling - use Message inside a plain container or Scroll Area.

items.name: transcript
items.title: Transcript
items.description: A timestamped, speaker-labelled transcript on MessageScroller's primitive - turns with a coloured speaker dot, the line playing at currentTime followed with a Back to current line button, seek from each timestamp, highlighted announced search, speaker chips with rename, and progressive mounting of long transcripts.

meta.whenToUse: The text of a recording - a meeting, call or interview - read alongside its player: timestamped speaker lines that follow playback, seek on click, and can be searched.
meta.whenNotToUse: A live chat or AI thread that pins to the newest message (MessageScroller with Message), or a chronological record of events rather than speech (Timeline).

items.name: meta-line
items.title: Meta Line
items.description: An icon + text meta line under a record title: wrapping facts such as type, date and time, duration and owner, in the muted ink.

meta.whenToUse: The facts line under a record's title — type, date and time, duration, who recorded it.
meta.whenNotToUse: Labelled key/value details (PropertyList) or status (Badge, StatusLine).

items.name: record-chip
items.title: Record Chip
items.description: A pill that shows the record something belongs to and picks another: icon, name and a chevron as a picker trigger, plus an arrow link to the record.

meta.whenToUse: Linking a record to another one in its header — a meeting's customer or project — with a picker and a jump to the linked record.
meta.whenNotToUse: A free-form tag (Chip) or a form field with a label (Combobox, Select).

items.name: status-line
items.title: Status Line
items.description: A slim inline status: info, progress (spinner) or error (destructive ink, role=alert), with an optional inline action.

meta.whenToUse: One line of status inside a record header — processing, a failure with its reason and Retry, a quiet notice.
meta.whenNotToUse: A page-level message with a title (Alert) or a transient confirmation (Toast).

items.name: use-tabs-swipe
items.title: useTabsSwipe
items.description: Switch controlled Tabs with a horizontal touch swipe on the panel area; vertical gestures stay a scroll and the direction follows RTL.

meta.whenToUse: Tabs over full-width panels on a phone, where a swipe between Summary / Action items / Transcript is expected.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabs whose panels scroll horizontally themselves (tables, carousels) — the gesture would fight them.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The platform <select>, tokenized — the OS picker on mobile, option groups, and the same chrome as every other field.

meta.whenToUse: A short list of plain options where the platform picker is the better experience — mobile forms, dense tables, settings rows.
meta.whenNotToUse: Options that need icons, descriptions or custom markup, or a list long enough to want search — use Select or Combobox.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site-nav mega-dropdown on the Base UI NavigationMenu primitive — chip triggers, one shared sliding panel, grid links.

meta.whenToUse: Top-level site/product navigation with rich dropdown panels.
meta.whenNotToUse: In-app action menus (DropdownMenu) or content tabs (Tabs).

items.name: inbox
items.title: Inbox
items.description: The notification Inbox: frame with header actions, All | Unread chips, sticky day groups, full-bleed rows with avatar or icon and an unread tint (no dot), rich titles, action chips, a fixed right column with the time over the hover actions (read toggle and menu), and empty, loading and error states.

meta.whenToUse: The notifications panel: a feed of person and system events the user reads, acts on and marks read. Put it in a Sheet, Popover or docked panel.
meta.whenNotToUse: Toasts for transient confirmations, an activity log on a record (Timeline), or a bare unread count (NotificationBell).

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: Notification Bell
items.description: A bell icon button with an unread-count badge overlay. Presentational — the app supplies the count.

meta.whenToUse: A bell trigger surfacing an unread count in app chrome — app owns the count and handler. Its NotificationDot is the one unread marker for rows, inbox items and nav items.
meta.whenNotToUse: The notifications panel itself, or a generic count badge (Badge).

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: Locale-aware numeric input on Base UI's NumberField in upstream's InputGroup chrome, with full-height flanking steppers.

meta.whenToUse: Any numeric value — quantities, limits, percentages, money (format={{ style: 'currency', currency }}) — where parsing, locale formatting, and stepping should be correct by construction.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-text that merely contains digits (phone numbers, postal codes, ids) — formatting/stepping semantics would fight the value; use Input.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The standardized header at the top of a page — back button, breadcrumb trail, title, description, actions, secondary menu, and a favorite star — plus SectionHeading for in-page section titles (sm and md sizes, a muted eyebrow variant, trailing actions).

meta.whenToUse: The header band at the top of a page — title plus back/breadcrumb nav (backRender for a framework link), actions, favorite, and a meta row that can hold badges and inline pickers.
meta.whenNotToUse: App-shell chrome (top nav/sidebar) or a section heading inside a page.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation — previous/next, numbered page links, an ellipsis for long ranges, and the active page.

meta.whenToUse: Navigate paged content with real URLs — a long list/table split across numbered pages; every page control is a link.
meta.whenNotToUse: Infinite scroll / 'load more' feeds, or tab-style switching.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: An anchored, dismissible surface for secondary content, with a header, title and description.

meta.whenToUse: Rich, interactive content anchored to a control — a small form, a picker, a details card.
meta.whenNotToUse: A short label (Tooltip), a list of actions (DropdownMenu), or anything that must block the page (Dialog).

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A horizontal progress bar for measurable, ongoing tasks — determinate or a sweeping indeterminate segment, built on Base UI Progress.

meta.whenToUse: Completion of a measurable task — uploads, multi-step forms, onboarding.
meta.whenNotToUse: Indefinite waits (Spinner) or radial percentage display (out of scope).

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A guided one-question-at-a-time form — choices, freeform answers, skip, shortcuts, validation, resume and conditional items, built on the @shadcn/react questionnaire state machine.

meta.whenToUse: An onboarding, survey or intake flow that asks one question at a time, validates each answer, and can be resumed.
meta.whenNotToUse: A conventional form where every field is visible at once — compose Field with the form primitives instead.

items.name: property-list
items.title: Property List
items.description: Record-facts rows: an icon+label column beside a value column, as an accessible definition list.

meta.whenToUse: Heterogeneous key→value panes (record details, metadata sidebars).
meta.whenNotToUse: Homogeneous collections (DataList/Table) or form editing (Field).

items.name: person-hover-card
items.title: Person Hover Card
items.description: Stacked avatars with a hover card per person — a compact card with a 32px avatar, with the name and muted email beside it — and the rest behind "+N".

meta.whenToUse: Show the people on a record (participants, watchers, a team) as stacked avatars, each previewing the person on hover, focus or tap.
meta.whenNotToUse: A picker of people (SearchableSelect) or a full member list (DataList).

items.name: record-aside
items.title: Record Aside
items.description: The cards of a record page's right rail — titled sections of inline properties, people, linked records and full-width action rows.

meta.whenToUse: A record page's rail cards (and its Details sheet): a Details section of inline properties, people and linked records, then sections of full-width rows for the record's tasks and suggestions.
meta.whenNotToUse: A full list page (DataList) or a settings form (Field).

items.name: provider
items.title: Provider
items.description: The single app-root wrapper — theme (next-themes), Base UI toasts, tooltip delays, and text direction in one mount-once component.

meta.whenToUse: Once, around your app root (layout.tsx) — every VegaStack component below it gets dark mode, working toast() calls, shared tooltip delays, and direction context.
meta.whenNotToUse: Anywhere below the root, or a second time — the bundled Toaster is a mount-once portal; pass toaster={false} if you must render your own.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of mutually-exclusive options — single selection, arrow-key navigation, and a 24px invisible hit area (A11Y-2). Built on Base UI Radio Group.

meta.whenToUse: A form value from 2–5 mutually-exclusive choices, all visible at once.
meta.whenNotToUse: An immediate view or scope switch over the same content (ToggleGroup), many options (Select), or non-exclusive multi-select (Checkboxes).

items.name: region-select
items.title: Region Select
items.description: A searchable picker of states/provinces for a country, with a free-text fallback for countries with no subdivisions. A thin wrapper over SearchableSelect fed by the geo-data item.

meta.whenToUse: A state/province as part of an address form, dependent on the selected country.
meta.whenNotToUse: A small country-independent option set (Select) or multi-select.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Dates & Times
items.description: One Intl-based dates & times module — formatRelative, formatDuration, formatDate, formatDateTime, formatDateRange, formatTimeOfDay, formatDueLabel, groupByDay, time-zone cookie + provider — and the RelativeTime, DateTime, Duration and DueLabel components with absolute-time tooltips.

meta.whenToUse: Any date, time, duration, due label or day grouping shown in UI — pick the function per the Dates & times page's where-to-use table.
meta.whenNotToUse: API/JSON output — keep ISO strings there.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Draggable, keyboard-resizable split panes — horizontal or vertical, nestable, with an optional collapsible panel. Built on react-resizable-panels.

meta.whenToUse: User-adjustable split layouts — code editor panes, sidebar + content, inspector panels.
meta.whenNotToUse: Fixed layouts, or layouts that only need to collapse/expand (Collapsible) without a drag/resize affordance.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scroll container with custom, auto-hiding scrollbars — dual-axis, token-styled, built on Base UI ScrollArea.

meta.whenToUse: Bounded panels whose content overflows — sidebars, log viewers, modal bodies, chat histories.
meta.whenNotToUse: Whole-page scrolling, or content that already fits.

items.name: searchable-select
items.title: Searchable Select
items.description: The Select-shaped Combobox preset: a full-width trigger, an in-panel search field, a tick on the selected row (matched by key, so async options tick too), a standard person option (name plus muted email, both searched) and an optional clear control. Single or multiple, controlled through value/onValueChange.

meta.whenToUse: A Select-shaped searchable picker: one or several values, option descriptions and disabled reasons, and server search with paging (remote + useAsyncSearch).
meta.whenNotToUse: A short fixed option set (Select), free text with suggestions (Combobox directly), or multi-select (Combobox with chips).

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a show/hide toggle, composed from InputGroup, forwarding every native input prop and the ref to the inner input.

meta.whenToUse: Any secret the user types — sign-in, sign-up, or a change-password form — where they may need to reveal what they typed.
meta.whenNotToUse: A one-time code (use InputOTP) or a non-secret text field.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: A token-safe search field with a consistent clear action, controlled and uncontrolled value handling, and native form semantics.

meta.whenToUse: A reusable search field with a consistent token-colored clear action, and a settled (debounced, Enter-flushed) value for sending the query.
meta.whenNotToUse: A general text field without search semantics, or a command palette with result navigation.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A dropdown for choosing one option — trigger with value and chevron, grouped scrollable popup, item-aligned positioning, and full keyboard navigation.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing from a short fixed, known set — statuses, sort orders, units — including grouped options; pass multiple for a multi-value select. The default trigger fills its parent; use variant="ghost" (with size="sm") for an inline trigger in table rows, list items and toolbars. A two-line option composes ItemTitle + ItemDescription, and the description is the option's accessible description.
meta.whenNotToUse: Boolean on/off (Switch), few inline options (radios), a list long enough to need a search field (SearchableSelect), or free-text/async search (Combobox).

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule dividing content — horizontal or vertical, built on Base UI.

meta.whenToUse: Divide distinct sections of content, menus, or toolbars.
meta.whenNotToUse: Pure spacing between elements — use margin/gap.

items.name: settings-row
items.title: Settings Row
items.description: A borders-only settings layout — titled sections, bordered cards, and label-plus-control rows.

meta.whenToUse: Settings/preferences screens — titled sections, bordered cards, label/description + control rows.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-form content surfaces (Card), data tables, or complex multi-field forms.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge — Dialog semantics with a side, a header and a footer; opens onto the first field, never the close ×; a left sheet can dock beside the sidebar rail (beside).

meta.whenToUse: Secondary content beside the page — filters, details, a settings panel, a long record form — that should not take the centre of the screen. Side sheets take size sm/default/lg/xl (Dialog's width scale); put long content in SheetBody so the footer stays on screen.
meta.whenNotToUse: A decision (AlertDialog), a centred form (Dialog), or a touch-first panel with snap points (Drawer).

items.name: shortcut-overlay
items.title: Shortcut Overlay
items.description: The ?-triggered dialog listing keyboard shortcuts, rendered from a declaration registry (keys, label, category, when) — grouped, filterable, platform-aware via use-platform + Kbd.

meta.whenToUse: Any app with keyboard shortcuts — declare each binding once (keys, label, category) and get the ?-dialog for free; the same data can feed tooltips and Command rows.
meta.whenNotToUse: Inline shortcut hints (Kbd in a Tooltip, CommandShortcut) or executing bindings — the app's key handler owns dispatch.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible app navigation rail — header/content/footer, labelled groups, menu items with active and open (menu-trigger) states, and an expand/collapse trigger.

meta.whenToUse: Primary app navigation in a dashboard/console shell — collapsible rail with grouped items.
meta.whenNotToUse: A few top-level links (horizontal nav) or transient small-viewport nav (Sheet).

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder that reserves layout space while content loads.

meta.whenToUse: Reserve layout space while content loads to avoid layout shift.
meta.whenNotToUse: Indeterminate progress with no known layout (Spinner) or determinate tasks (progress bar).

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number or a range from a continuous track — horizontal or vertical, any number of thumbs, each with a 24px invisible hit area (A11Y-2).

meta.whenToUse: An imprecise value over a bounded range — volume, brightness, a price filter.
meta.whenNotToUse: Exact values or large/open ranges (number input); on/off (Switch).

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable List
items.description: Reorderable rows or tiles on ItemGroup/Item via use-drag-reorder — pointer drag with drop indicators, keyboard move mode, a lossless row menu, locked rows, inline actions, a grid layout, and server-refusable moves. Controlled; the host owns the order.

meta.whenToUse: User-orderable single lists and tile grids — settings sections, pipeline stages, attribute values with locked built-ins, editable rows with inline actions, ordered product photos — where the host persists (and may refuse) the order.
meta.whenNotToUse: Cross-container card movement (board), selectable data tables (DataList — never mix selection with reordering), or read-only lists (ItemGroup).

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator that inherits its host's ink.

meta.whenToUse: Signal an indeterminate, in-progress load — inside a button or a loading region.
meta.whenNotToUse: Showing measurable progress (progress bar) or a skeleton-able layout (skeleton).

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A labelled value block — muted label over a value, honest faint empty state, optional delta line. Two scales.

meta.whenToUse: Record highlights and dashboard stat tiles where a value needs a quiet label.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabular data (Table/DataList) or live-updating counters (AnimatedNumber inside StatValue is fine).

items.name: priority-icon
items.title: Priority Icon
items.description: A flag marking priority — urgent, high, medium, low, none — each in a semantic color with filled, outline or dashed fill.

meta.whenToUse: Show a task or item's priority in rows, cards and pickers — beside StatusIcon.
meta.whenNotToUse: Status (StatusIcon) or a severity message (Alert, Badge).

items.name: status-icon
items.title: Status Icon
items.description: A small status indicator icon — todo, in progress, blocked, done, cancelled — each mapping to a lucide icon and semantic color.

meta.whenToUse: Indicate the state of a task or item — todo, in progress, blocked, or done — alongside a label.
meta.whenNotToUse: Measurable progress (Progress), generic loading (Spinner), or priority (PriorityIcon).

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A bounded linear process as an ordered list — seven step states on a numbered rail that fills in behind you, aria-current=step, orientation chosen from the step count, and a compact summary below a container width.

meta.whenToUse: Any bounded linear process — onboarding, wizards, checkout, import flows — where progress, a failed or skipped step, and a step being checked must all be communicated.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free navigation between peer views (Tabs), or the reason a flow cannot advance — that belongs beside the control it blocks, not in the rail.

items.name: multi-step-form
items.title: Multi-Step Form
items.description: A guarded, branching flow around a Stepper — conditional steps, sync and async advance guards, locking, reachability-derived deep links and resume, a panel layout for dialogs, an unsaved-work exit guard, and a phone layout chosen from the same predicate. Owns no fields and no validator.

meta.whenToUse: A process a person drives across several screens — signup, checkout, an import wizard, a multi-section record editor — where steps can branch, an advance can be refused, and a committed step must not be walked back into.
meta.whenNotToUse: Progress the system drives and a person only reads (Stepper alone), free navigation between peer views (Tabs), or one question at a time (Questionnaire).

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off toggle for instant, self-saving binary settings — two sizes and a 24px invisible hit area (A11Y-2). Built on Base UI Switch.

meta.whenToUse: Settings that apply instantly — notifications, dark mode, feature flags.
meta.whenNotToUse: Inside a form needing a Submit step — use a Checkbox.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Styled semantic table primitives — a scrollable container plus header, body, footer, row, head, cell, caption.

meta.whenToUse: Display tabular data with header/body/footer rows — lists, comparisons, summaries.
meta.whenNotToUse: Page layout or non-tabular content — use a grid/flex layout.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Layered content sections — default (segmented) or line variants, compact size, optional leading icons and counts, horizontal or vertical, full keyboard navigation. Toolbar switches use default Tabs: scope (My tasks | Team tasks) and views, whose List/Board/Grid switch is ViewToggle (default Tabs with icons). The one component that keeps a focus ring.

meta.whenToUse: Organize related content into peer sections the user switches between in place; a count after a trigger's label is an aria-hidden tabular number plus an sr-only suffix, so it reads as part of the tab's name. A line list scrolls sideways inside itself when the tabs outnumber the width; orientation="vertical" suits a stable column of settings sections. For tabs that are separate pages, draw a nav of links from tabsListVariants and tabsTriggerVariants with aria-current="page" (route tabs).
meta.whenNotToUse: Sequential multi-step flows (stepper), single-select form input (radio/select), sections that must be visible at once, or page-level navigation rendered as a tablist — route tabs are links, not tabs.

items.name: tag-group
items.title: Tag Group
items.description: Hue-tinted label chips on the 10-hue tag palette, with +N overflow collapsing and removable tags.

meta.whenToUse: Decorative record labels/categories in rows that may overflow — the label voice.
meta.whenNotToUse: Status signals (Badge) or interactive filters (Combobox chips).

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A dark mono command block with a phosphor prompt glyph and a composed copy button.

meta.whenToUse: Install snippets and short, copyable command sequences on a marketing surface.
meta.whenNotToUse: Long-form code samples — use a standard code block.

items.name: text-edit
items.title: Text Edit
items.description: A Tiptap markdown-first rich-text editor in the shared prose typography — a slash menu and a bubble menu instead of a toolbar, a link popover, task lists, tables, code blocks, markdown input rules and paste, and one onCommit path.

meta.whenToUse: Comments, notes, summaries and documents stored as Markdown (format="markdown") or HTML; in-place editing of a MarkdownView with variant="ghost".
meta.whenNotToUse: Plain single-line input (Input) or collaborative real-time docs (deferred text-edit-collab).

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A styled native textarea for multi-line text — auto-sizing to its content, invalid and disabled chrome, and the text-entry focus border tint (FOC-3).

meta.whenToUse: Multi-line free text — descriptions, comments, messages, notes.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single-line entry (input), rich text (editor), or fixed options (select).

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Rail geometry for chronological records — a continuous connector with a node per entry. Rows compose Item parts; separators render through Marker; entries carry content-visibility render skipping.

meta.whenToUse: Chronological records — activity feeds, audit trails, delivery logs — where entries need a visible temporal thread (rail + node) and rows compose Item/RelativeTime/Avatar.
meta.whenNotToUse: Live bottom-pinned conversation feeds (MessageScroller), bounded processes with gating (Stepper), or plain lists with no temporal thread (ItemGroup).

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief, non-blocking notifications — a stacking Base UI Toast surface with typed icons, actions and promise toasts.

meta.whenToUse: Brief confirmations of an action — 'Saved', 'Copied', 'Invitation sent' — and the loading → success/error arc of an async one.
meta.whenNotToUse: Errors the user must resolve, destructive confirmations, or essential info — use inline copy or a Dialog.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that can be pressed on or off, with a loading state (API-5).

meta.whenToUse: A binary on/off control that persists — bold/italic, mute, pin.
meta.whenNotToUse: One-shot action (Button) or mutually-exclusive options (ToggleGroup/RadioGroup).

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle buttons sharing one selection — single or multiple, horizontal or vertical.

meta.whenToUse: An immediate view or scope switch over the same content (Mine | Team, Grid | List) — pass deselectable={false} so one item always stays pressed — or related toggle buttons such as formatting; wrap lets a long option set fall onto rows on a narrow screen.
meta.whenNotToUse: A form value (RadioGroup), swapping page regions (Tabs), moving between URLs (links), or a single on/off control (Toggle/Switch).

items.name: tool-call-chip
items.title: Tool Call Chip
items.description: An agent-activity chip — tool action label + muted result meta, optionally rendered as a button.

meta.whenToUse: Tool invocations in an agent/chat transcript (searched, executed, created).
meta.whenNotToUse: Status badges (Badge) or long-running task rows (Marker + Spinner).

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A floating label on hover or focus, portaled inside the theme scope (OVL-13).

meta.whenToUse: Short supplementary labels on icon buttons, toolbar actions, and controls — optionally with a shortcut hint.
meta.whenNotToUse: Interactive content (links/buttons) or essential information — a tooltip isn't reliably reachable; use a Popover.

items.name: truncated-text
items.title: Truncated Text
items.description: Truncate text to one line or N lines with an ellipsis, revealing the full text in a tooltip only when it overflows — with per-region control over the tab stop.

meta.whenToUse: Long values in constrained layouts — table cells, nav labels, IDs/paths.
meta.whenNotToUse: Essential action text or content that must be fully visible.

items.name: use-animation-replay
items.title: useAnimationReplay / useShakeOnInvalid
items.description: Replay a mount-style CSS animation (e.g. motion-shake) on demand via class-toggle, without remounting the element — preserves focus/caret/selection on form controls. Includes useShakeOnInvalid, the auto-shake-on-invalid-transition convenience built on it.

meta.whenToUse: Replaying a motion-* utility on a user action (error shake, retry pop, etc.), especially on an element that might be focused (form controls) where a key-remount would steal focus.
meta.whenNotToUse: One-shot mount animations that never need to replay — just apply the motion-* class directly.

items.name: use-announcer
items.title: useAnnouncer
items.description: The one polite live region — announce(text) plus a stable Announcer component, sequence-keyed so an identical consecutive announcement is still spoken.

meta.whenToUse: Any component that must tell a screen-reader user something happened with no focus change — a row moved, an entry was rejected, a save failed.
meta.whenNotToUse: Content that is visible on screen anyway and already announced by focus, or an assertive alert (role=alert is a separate policy).

items.name: use-async-search
items.title: useAsyncSearch
items.description: The server-search state machine for a searched, cursor-paged list — debounced query, abortable requests with stale responses dropped, cursor paging as a LoadMoreState, and errors that keep the loaded items.

meta.whenToUse: Server-side search over a list that pages by cursor: a remote SearchableSelect, a searched facet, a picker dialog, a searched DataList — debounce, races, paging and retry in one hook.
meta.whenNotToUse: Filtering items already in memory (pass them to the component and let it filter); a one-shot fetch with no query (use your data library directly).

items.name: use-drag-reorder
items.title: useDragReorder
items.description: The system's one drag engine seam — Pragmatic drag-and-drop pointer/touch mechanics plus the house keyboard move mode, live-region vocabulary, and async pending/rejected drop contract. One API for single lists and cross-container boards.

meta.whenToUse: Any reorder-by-drag surface — sortable lists, wrapped tile grids (`columns` for row-aware ↑/↓), board cards, a future bespoke drag surface — where pointer, keyboard move mode, announcements, and server-refusable drops must all work from one API.
meta.whenNotToUse: File drag-in (use-file-drop), resizing panes (Resizable), or single-axis value dragging (Slider).

items.name: use-file-drop
items.title: useFileDrop
items.description: File acquisition (drop, browse, paste) over the sanctioned react-dropzone engine — typed rejection reasons aligned with Attachment's state prop, announcement payload, window-level missed-drop protection.

meta.whenToUse: Any surface that acquires files — a Dropzone, a rich-text composer accepting pasted screenshots, a bespoke drop target — where drag-depth handling, accept matching, and typed rejections should be correct by construction.
meta.whenNotToUse: Rendering upload state (Attachment) or persisting uploads — acquisition ends at the File[] callback.

items.name: use-inline-edit
items.title: useInlineEdit
items.description: The click-to-edit state machine - draft, commit, cancel, focus restoration and the double-commit guard - with no opinion about what the editor or the display look like.

meta.whenToUse: Any click-to-edit surface: an inline field, a grid cell, a rename affordance - anywhere Enter commits, Escape cancels, and blur must not commit twice.
meta.whenNotToUse: A field that is always in edit mode (Input inside a Field); persistence, async status or optimistic revert, which belong to the component composing this hook.

items.name: use-list-nav
items.title: useListNav
items.description: Roving-tabindex keyboard navigation for a list or grid of focusable items — one Tab stop per collection, RTL-aware arrows, Home/End jumps scoped to the collection or the row.

meta.whenToUse: Any hand-rolled collection of focusable items that should read as ONE Tab stop with arrow-key movement — swatch grids, emoji grids, card lists, custom pickers.
meta.whenNotToUse: Base UI-owned collections (Select, Combobox, Menu, Tabs) — their primitives already own roving focus; and single controls that need no internal navigation.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery / usePrefersReducedMotion
items.description: The system's one matchMedia subscription — useSyncExternalStore with a declared serverFallback, so SSR renders the branch the caller chose instead of a hard-coded false. usePrefersReducedMotion is the named reduced-motion reader over it.

meta.whenToUse: JavaScript genuinely has to branch on a media query — mounting a different component tree, skipping a requestAnimationFrame loop, enabling pointer drag.
meta.whenNotToUse: A purely visual responsive change: a Tailwind breakpoint or a container query does it in CSS with no hydration cost.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: SSR-safe viewport-width hook over use-media-query — reports whether the viewport is below a breakpoint (default 768px), live across resizes, with a caller-declared server fallback.

meta.whenToUse: Switching a layout between desktop and mobile treatments (e.g. Sidebar's rail vs. Sheet mode) based on real viewport width.
meta.whenNotToUse: CSS-only responsive layout — reach for a Tailwind breakpoint utility instead when no JS branching is needed.

items.name: use-modal-inert
items.title: useModalInert
items.description: Mirror Base UI's live modal-stack markers to native inert with reference-counted ownership while preserving region-level notifications.

meta.whenToUse: Inside a Base UI modal popup wrapper whose outside subtrees carry data-base-ui-inert but remain keyboard-focusable without the native inert property; region-level live notification surfaces remain exempt.
meta.whenNotToUse: Non-modal or trap-focus-only popups that intentionally preserve outside pointer interaction; component consumers install it transitively rather than calling it directly.

items.name: use-overflow
items.title: useOverflow
items.description: Live overflow measurement — report whether an element is clipped on the inline axis, the block axis, or either, across resizes and content changes.

meta.whenToUse: Deciding something only when content is ACTUALLY clipped — offering a reveal affordance for truncated text, or making a scroll viewport focusable only while it can scroll.
meta.whenNotToUse: Layout CSS can express on its own (line-clamp, overflow) with no JavaScript branch hanging off the measurement.

items.name: use-platform
items.title: usePlatform
items.description: SSR-safe platform detection — { os, isTouch } from navigator.userAgentData with a navigator.platform fallback, corrected after hydration with no mismatch warning.

meta.whenToUse: Any copy or control that branches on modifier-key conventions (Kbd's os prop, shortcut hints, Command footers) or on a coarse pointer; formatShortcutKey / formatShortcut turn "mod" into ⌘ or Ctrl.
meta.whenNotToUse: Viewport-width layout switching — that is useIsMobile; and never wire it inside Kbd itself, which must stay server-safe.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video Player
items.description: A framed video player with the same grouped custom transport controls as Audio Player.

meta.whenToUse: A single video asset that needs a branded frame plus grouped skip controls, mute, and keyboard shortcuts.
meta.whenNotToUse: Playlists, caption editing, fullscreen-first viewing, or adaptive streaming control surfaces.

items.title: App Shell 01
items.description: The application shell reference — AppShell's landmarks and skip link, a rail with search, inbox count, grouped links and a user menu, and a page of linked stat tiles.

meta.whenNotToUse: You only need the shell mechanics in many places — install the app-shell component and compose it yourself.

items.title: Board 01

items.name: login-01
items.title: Login 01
items.description: A sign-in page: email and password with a field error each, a forgot-password link, and an alert after a rejected sign-in.

meta.whenToUse: Sign-in page for an app — copy it once, then wire signIn to your auth provider.
meta.whenNotToUse: Sign-up or password reset — reuse this card frame with their own fields (see the block's docs page); a tracked component to import in many places — install the components it composes instead.

items.name: settings-01
items.title: Settings 01
items.description: A settings page — PageHeader over grouped SettingsRow sections, an ActionBar save bar that appears once something changed, and a confirmed delete.

meta.whenToUse: Starting a preferences, profile or workspace-settings route — copy it once and wire each row to your own state.
meta.whenNotToUse: One setting inside another page — compose settings-row directly.

items.name: settings-02
items.title: Settings 02
items.description: A settings hub — one titled section per area, each a grid of whole-tile links with one fact apiece.

meta.whenToUse: The settings landing page that links to each settings area — copy it once and point each tile at your routes.
meta.whenNotToUse: Editing settings in place — use settings-01, or compose settings-row directly.

items.name: status-pages-01
items.title: Status Pages 01
items.description: The 404, 403 and error pages — an Empty whose title is the page's h1, one way out, and the error's reference to copy.

meta.whenToUse: Your app's not-found, forbidden and error boundary pages, in the shell or standalone — copy the page each boundary file needs.
meta.whenNotToUse: An empty list or a failed section inside a page — compose Empty with the empty-state tiers instead.

items.name: review-split-01
items.title: Review Split 01
items.description: A record review page — summary and action items beside a sticky transcript, with a docked player, turning into tabs when its own container is narrow.

meta.whenToUse: A detail page that reviews a record against a long companion pane, such as a meeting with its transcript — copy it once and wire your record.
meta.whenNotToUse: A plain detail page with one column — compose AppShellPage and PageHeader directly.

items.name: list-page-01
items.title: List Page 01
items.description: A list page — FilterBar search, a Status facet and Mine | Team over the same records as a table or a grid of linked tiles, with Load more and three empty tiers.

meta.whenToUse: A page that lists one kind of record — customers, products, projects — copy it once and wire the filters, paging and routes to your API.
meta.whenNotToUse: A small list inside another page — compose DataList or an ItemGroup directly.

items.name: notifications-01
items.title: Notifications 01
items.description: An Inbox sheet on the Inbox component — rail row and bell triggers with the unread count, Mark all read and ⋯, All | Unread chips, day groups of linked rows with avatars, unread tint and action chips, and Load older.

meta.whenToUse: Your app's notification inbox, opened from the shell — copy it once and wire the rows, Mark all read and paging to your API.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single transient message — use a toast; an activity history on a record — use Timeline.

items.name: command-search-01
items.title: Command Search 01
items.description: A search palette — scope chips, recents, results grouped by type, loading, empty and error states, and ⌘↵ to open in a new tab.

meta.whenToUse: App-wide search behind ⌘K and the sidebar's Search row — copy it once and pass your search call.
meta.whenNotToUse: Filtering one list in place — use FilterBar's search.
